022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.layout.ConditionalRenderComponent;

029import java.util.ArrayList;

034/**
035 * IShopLayoutProvider
036 *
037 * @author creatorfromhell
038 * @since 6.2.0.11
039 */
040public interface IShopLayoutProvider {
041
042  /**
043   * Provides a list of {@link ItemComponent} objects, each representing a component associated
044   * with an item in the context of a shop layout.
045   *
046   * @return a list of {@link ItemComponent} objects representing the item components.
047   */
048  List<ItemComponent> itemComponents();
049
050  /**
051   * A list of components that represent various aspects of a text-display layout or sign.
052   *
053   * @return a list of {@link RenderComponent} objects representing the render components
054   * @since 6.3.0.0
055   */
056  List<RenderComponent> renderComponents();
057
058  /**
059   * Filters the list of render components to include only those that are full line replacements.
060   *
061   * @return a list of {@link RenderComponent} objects representing components that replace entire lines
062   * @since 6.3.0.0
063   */
064  default List<RenderComponent> fullLineRenderComponents() {
065
066    return renderComponents().stream().filter(RenderComponent::fullLine).toList();
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Filters the list of render components to include only those that are not full line replacements.
071   *
072   * @return a list of {@link RenderComponent} objects representing components that do not replace entire lines
073   * @since 6.3.0.0
074   */
075  default List<RenderComponent> inlineRenderComponents() {
076    return renderComponents().stream().filter(component -> !component.fullLine()).toList();
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Generates a layout template for the specified shop.
081   *
082   * @param shop the shop instance for which the layout template is to be generated
083   * @return a LinkedList of Strings representing the layout template of the shop
084   */
085  LinkedList<String> layoutTemplate(final Shop shop);
086
087  /**
088   * Creates a snapshot of a shop sign that encapsulates the visual and structural data required
089   * to render the sign, based on the specified shop and locale.
090   *
091   * @param shop the shop instance for which the sign snapshot is to be created
092   * @param locale the locale to be used for formatting and rendering the snapshot
093   * @return a CompletableFuture that completes with a SignRenderSnapshot, representing
094   *         the state of the shop sign
095   */
096  CompletableFuture<SignRenderSnapshot> createSignSnapshot(@NotNull Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
097
098  /**
099   * Renders a snapshot of a shop sign into a list of components based on the provided locale.
100   *
101   * @param snapshot the snapshot representing the current state of the shop sign to be rendered
102   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the components
103   * @return a list of components representing the rendered shop sign snapshot
104   */
105  default List<Component> renderSnapshot(final SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, final ProxiedLocale locale) {
106
107    final List<Component> rendered = new ArrayList<>(4);
108
109    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
110      if (snapshot.template().size() <= i || snapshot.template().get(i).isBlank()) {
111        rendered.add(Component.empty());
112        continue;
113      }
114
115      final String line = snapshot.template().get(i);
116
117      boolean isFullLine = false;
118      for (final RenderComponent component : fullLineRenderComponents()) {
119
120        if (!component.supportsSnapshot()) {
121          continue;
122        }
123
124        if (!component.appliesTo(line)) {
125          continue;
126        }
127
128        rendered.add(component.renderSnapshot(snapshot, locale));
129        isFullLine = true;
130        break;
131
132      }
133
134      if (isFullLine) {
135        continue;
136      }
137
138      Component lineComponent = MiniMessage.miniMessage().deserialize(line);
139      for (final RenderComponent component : inlineRenderComponents()) {
140
141        if (!component.supportsSnapshot()) {
142          continue;
143        }
144
145        if (!component.appliesTo(line)) {
146          continue;
147        }
148
149        if (component instanceof final ConditionalRenderComponent conditionalComponent && conditionalComponent.isFullLine(snapshot)) {
150          lineComponent = conditionalComponent.renderSnapshot(snapshot, locale);
151          break;
152        }
153
154        lineComponent = lineComponent.replaceText(builder -> builder
155                .matchLiteral(component.placeholder())
156                .replacement(component.renderSnapshot(snapshot, locale)));
157      }
158      rendered.add(lineComponent);
159    }
160
161    return rendered;
162  }
163
164  /**
165   * Renders the header section of a shop sign snapshot into a component based on the provided locale.
166   *
167   * @param snapshot the snapshot representing the current state of the shop sign's header to be rendered
168   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the header component
169   * @return a component representing the rendered header section of the shop sign snapshot
170   *
171   * @deprecated Individual render methods replaced my the render component system.
172   */
173  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
174  Component renderHeaderSnapshot(final SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, final ProxiedLocale locale);
175
176  /**
177   * Renders the trading section of a shop sign snapshot into a component based on the provided locale.
178   *
179   * @param snapshot the snapshot representing the current state of the shop sign's trading section to be rendered
180   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the trading component
181   * @return a component representing the rendered trading section of the shop sign snapshot
182   *
183   * @deprecated Individual render methods replaced my the render component system.
184   */
185  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
186  Component renderTradingSnapshot(final SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, final ProxiedLocale locale);
187
188  /**
189   * Renders the price section of a shop sign snapshot into a component based on the provided locale.
190   *
191   * @param snapshot the snapshot representing the current state of the shop sign to be rendered
192   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the price component
193   * @return a component representing the rendered price section of the shop sign snapshot
194   *
195   * @deprecated Individual render methods replaced my the render component system.
196   */
197  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
198  Component renderPriceSnapshot(final SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, final ProxiedLocale locale);
199
200  /**
201   * Renders the layout of the specified shop into a list of components based on the provided locale.
202   *
203   * @param shop the shop instance for which the components are to be rendered
204   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the components
205   * @return a LinkedList of components representing the visual layout of the shop
206   */
207  LinkedList<Component> render(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
208
209  /**
210   * Renders the header section of the specified shop into a component.
211   *
212   * @param shop the shop instance for which the header component is to be rendered
213   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the header component
214   * @return a component representing the visual header of the shop
215   *
216   * @deprecated Individual render methods replaced my the render component system.
217   */
218  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
219  Component renderHeader(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
220
221  /**
222   * Renders the trading section of the specified shop into a component.
223   *
224   * @param shop the shop instance for which the trading component is to be rendered
225   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the trading component
226   * @return a component representing the visual trading section of the shop
227   *
228   * @deprecated Individual render methods replaced my the render component system.
229   */
230  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
231  Component renderTrading(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
232
233  /**
234   * Renders an item section of the specified shop into a component based on the provided locale.
235   *
236   * @param shop the shop instance for which the item component is to be rendered
237   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the item component
238   * @return a component representing the visual item section of the shop
239   *
240   * @deprecated Individual render methods replaced my the render component system.
241   */
242  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
243  Component renderItem(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
244
245  /**
246   * Renders the price section of the specified shop into a component based on the provided locale.
247   *
248   * @param shop the shop instance for which the price component is to be rendered
249   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the price component
250   * @return a component representing the visual price section of the shop
251   *
252   * @deprecated Individual render methods replaced my the render component system.
253   */
254  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
255  Component renderPrice(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ProxiedLocale locale);
256
257  /**
258   * Renders the enchantment level for books, or the duration for potions into a component based on the provided locale.
259   *
260   * @param shop the shop instance for which the level component is to be rendered
261   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the level component
262   * @return a component representing the visual level section of the shop
263   *
264   * @deprecated Individual render methods replaced my the render component system.
265   */
266  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
267  Component renderLevels(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull ProxiedLocale locale);
268}
